webhook_receiver.description: Generic webhook receiver with HMAC validation and event bus routing
webhook_receiver.scaffold:
import hmac, hashlib
from fastapi import Request, HTTPException

@app.post('/webhook')
async def receive_webhook(request: Request):
    body = await request.body()
    sig = request.headers.get('X-Garcar-Signature', '')
    expected = hmac.new(WEBHOOK_SECRET.encode(), body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(sig, f'sha256={expected}'):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail='Invalid signature')
    payload = await request.json()
    await event_bus.emit(f'garcar.{SYSTEM_ID}.webhook.received', payload)
    return {'received': True}

auto_rollback.description: Auto-rollback deployment on health check failure post-deploy
auto_rollback.scaffold:
async def deploy_with_rollback(new_image: str, current_image: str):
    await deploy(new_image)
    await asyncio.sleep(30)
    health = await check_health()
    if health['status'] != 'healthy':
        await deploy(current_image)
        await event_bus.emit(f'garcar.{SYSTEM_ID}.deploy.rollback', {'rolled_back_to': current_image, 'reason': health})
        return False
    return True

drift_detection.description: Config drift detection — alerts when runtime state diverges from declared state
drift_detection.scaffold:
import hashlib, json

async def detect_drift(expected_config: dict, actual_config: dict) -> bool:
    expected_hash = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(expected_config, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
    actual_hash = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(actual_config, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
    if expected_hash != actual_hash:
        await event_bus.emit(f'garcar.{SYSTEM_ID}.drift.detected', {'expected_hash': expected_hash, 'actual_hash': actual_hash})
        return True
    return False

auth_layer.description: JWT/API-key auth middleware for all protected routes
auth_layer.scaffold:
from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, Security
from fastapi.security import HTTPBearer, HTTPAuthorizationCredentials
import jwt

security = HTTPBearer()

async def verify_token(credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security)):
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(credentials.credentials, JWT_SECRET, algorithms=['HS256'])
        return payload
    except jwt.ExpiredSignatureError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail='Token expired')
    except jwt.InvalidTokenError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail='Invalid token')
